newsitem.title: USA: Crescent to pay $383 mln for Carter-Crawley.
newsitem.headline: Crescent to pay $383 mln for Carter-Crawley.

text.p: Crescent Real Estate Equities Co said on Tuesday that the value of its previously announced purchase of the assets of Carter-Crawley Properties Inc was $383 million.
Terms of the deal had not been disclosed when it was announced February 13.

The purchase included 14 office properties in the suburban Dallas area with a total of 3 million square feet; 1221 acres of commercially zoned, undeveloped land in the Dallas-Fort Worth area; and equity and debt interests in the Dallas Mavericks National Basketball Association franchise.
Crescent also said it acquired the AT&T office building in downtown Denver and two other buildings in that area for a total of $42.7 million.
